JD001.title: Senior Data Engineer
JD001.about:
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our 
Healthcare Analytics team. You will design and maintain large-scale 
data pipelines that power clinical decision-making across our hospital 
network. You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, and 
clinical stakeholders.
JD001.responsibilities:
- Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Python and Spark
- Manage and optimize large SQL databases
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and lead data engineering initiatives
- Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance at scale
- Document data flows and mentor junior engineers
JD001.requirements:
- Strong proficiency in Python (must have)
- Experience with Apache Spark for large-scale data processing (must have)
- Advanced SQL skills (must have)
- Experience building and maintaining data pipelines (must have)
- Leadership and team collaboration skills (must have)
JD001.nice_to_have:
- Experience in healthcare domain or familiarity with clinical data
- Experience with dbt (data build tool)

JD002.title: ML Engineer
JD002.about:
We are hiring an ML Engineer to join our core AI team. 
You will build, train, and deploy machine learning models that power 
our intelligent product features. You will work in a fast-paced 
environment where your models go directly into production.
JD002.responsibilities:
- Design and train machine learning models using TensorFlow and PyTorch
- Deploy and monitor models in production environments
- Apply statistical analysis to validate model performance
- Communicate model results and limitations to technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Write clean, maintainable ML code
JD002.requirements:
- Strong Python programming skills (must have)
- Hands-on experience with TensorFlow for model development (must have)
- Experience deploying ML models to production (must have)
- Solid understanding of statistics and probability (must have)
- Strong communication skills to explain model decisions (must have)
JD002.nice_to_have:
- Experience with PyTorch in addition to TensorFlow
- Familiarity with Docker for containerized ML deployments

JD003.title: Healthcare IT Manager
JD003.about:
We are seeking an experienced Healthcare IT Manager to 
oversee our clinical systems team. You will manage a team of 6 IT 
professionals and be responsible for the reliability and compliance 
of all clinical technology systems across our organization.
JD003.responsibilities:
- Lead and manage a team of 6 healthcare IT professionals
- Oversee implementation and maintenance of EHR systems
- Ensure compliance with HIPAA regulations and healthcare data standards
- Manage HL7 integrations between clinical systems
- Drive IT project planning, budgeting, and execution
JD003.requirements:
- Deep knowledge of HIPAA compliance and healthcare data privacy (must have)
- Experience with HL7 messaging standards (must have)
- Hands-on experience with EHR systems such as Epic or Cerner (must have)
- Proven leadership and people management experience (must have)
- Strong project management skills (must have)
JD003.nice_to_have:
- Programming experience, particularly Python
- Familiarity with FHIR standards for healthcare data exchange

JD004.title: Data Science Lead
JD004.about: We are looking for an experienced Data Science Lead to head our analytics team. You will lead a team of 5 data scientists and engineers, driving the strategy and execution of machine learning initiatives across the organization. You will be responsible for both technical delivery and people management.
JD004.responsibilities:
Lead and manage a team of 5 data scientists and ML engineers.
Define and execute the machine learning roadmap for the organization.
Oversee model development, deployment, and monitoring in production.
Drive collaboration between data science, engineering, and business teams.
Mentor and grow junior data scientists.
Present insights and model results to executive stakeholders.
JD004.requirements:
Proven experience leading and managing a data science or ML team (must have).
Strong Python programming skills (must have).
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch for model development (must have).
Experience deploying and monitoring ML models in production (must have).
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills (must have).
Strong statistical foundations and analytical thinking (must have).
JD004.nice_to_have:
Experience with Apache Spark for large scale data processing.
Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices.
Experience in healthcare or clinical data science.

JD005.title: Clinical Data Analyst
JD005.about: We are seeking a Clinical Data Analyst to bridge the gap between healthcare operations and data analytics. You will work with clinical teams to extract insights from EHR data, ensure data privacy compliance, and build analytical pipelines that support clinical decision making. This is a hybrid role requiring both technical and healthcare domain expertise.
JD005.responsibilities:
Extract, transform, and analyze clinical data from EHR systems.
Build and maintain data pipelines using Python and SQL.
Ensure all data handling complies with HIPAA regulations.
Collaborate with clinical teams to understand data requirements.
Develop dashboards and reports for clinical stakeholders.
Document data flows and maintain data dictionaries.
JD005.requirements:
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and pipeline development (must have).
Strong SQL skills for querying clinical databases (must have).
Knowledge of HIPAA compliance and healthcare data privacy (must have).
Experience working with EHR systems such as Epic or Cerner (must have).
Strong communication skills to work with clinical stakeholders (must have).
JD005.nice_to_have:
Experience with HL7 or FHIR data standards.
Familiarity with healthcare data warehousing.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
